First, time-lock the stake. A new identity deposits 150 units into a vault for 20 epochs, no early exit; the lock is the thread tying one identity to one timeline, so a farmer cannot recycle the same capital across a grove of fakes.

Then, release it slowly: each honest epoch unlocks 5% as reward; verified forgery freezes the remainder and resets the 20-epoch clock.

Finally, price the attack. Forging 1,000 identities locks 150,000 units for 20 epochs; a 30% detection rate slashes 60% of caught stakes, a 27,000-unit loss, and frozen capital cannot fund the next lotus crop.
